purpose: Prepared first real-data layer of the multiscale model. This is an INGESTION CONTRACT, not data. No source, measurement, coordinate, datum, material value or citation is attached yet.
rule: A numeric value may be promoted from idealized_design to a provenance-bearing class only after a source record with a verifiable identifier, declared datum, method and uncertainty is attached AND external_citations_attached is switched to true by the project owner. Until then every numeric value stays synthetic and all missing quantities stay null/unknown.
minimum_evidence_bar: Identifier resolves to an independently checkable record.
Coordinate frame and vertical datum are stated; proxy/map-derived values are labelled separately from surveyed control points.
Present visible surface, latent parent-mass boundary and reconstructed intact candidate are kept as distinct fields.
Uncertainty and method are reported; missing fields remain null rather than being filled with averages.
At least one competing explanation is recorded for any causal interpretation.

first_layer_targets.needed: Survey-linked volume, footprint and orientation with declared datum and uncertainty
Borehole/logging profile, measured site impedance and a stated synthetic-to-real domain truncation
Sourced density, elastic moduli and attenuation with laboratory method and sample provenance
Measured radiating area, medium density/wave speed and a validated radiation-impedance model for the chosen band
Co-located calibrated ambient seismic/acoustic/EM time series with matching band and time window
Documented water table, permeability and subsurface survey before any cavity or pressure-coupling term is added

forbidden_until_sources_verified: Promoting any synthetic value to measured_current, published_measurement, historical_record, geologically_inferred or reconstructed_uncertain.
Asserting a historical function or role for any functional object.
Adding a cavity, chamber, conduit or original Sphinx form without survey evidence.
Using a synthetic background comparator to claim bounded_negligible or attribution.
Connecting a pyramid-local mode directly to a planetary or cosmic mode.
